Entering the tunnel, the green traffic light ahead blends with the green-tinted tunnel lights, but the go signal is still clearly distinguishable.
In heavy city traffic, the green light allows our line of cars to proceed, while pedestrians still crossing on the far side cause cautious driving.

name: Yellow
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: The traffic light ahead turns yellow as I approach the intersection, and I gently apply the brakes to come to a smooth stop.
A bright yellow school bus stops on the two-lane road in front of me, its red lights flashing and stop arm extended, so I bring my vehicle to a complete halt.
Driving on a winding mountain road at dusk, yellow warning signs with chevron arrows indicate a sharp curve, reflecting my headlights clearly.
Heavy urban traffic: the yellow double solid line in the center separates opposing lanes, and I maintain my lane carefully.
Through the windshield, I see a construction zone ahead marked by yellow diamond signs and cones, prompting me to reduce speed.
At a signal-controlled pedestrian crossing near a school, the yellow phase begins flashing, warning me that the light will soon turn red.
The city street has a yellow-painted curb indicating a loading zone, where a delivery truck is temporarily parked, so I signal and merge left.
Night driving on the expressway, the yellow high-intensity reflective strips on the guardrail and road signs enhance visibility, guiding my path.

name: Brown
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: Ahead on the rural dirt road, a brown cargo truck with a faded earthy paint job merges gently with the dry fields on both sides, its low reflectivity making it almost indistinguishable from the terrain in the late afternoon sun.

While driving through a rustic farm area, the vehicle-mounted camera picks up a figure in a dark brown coat crossing near a wooden fence; the earth tone of the clothing blends into the background of hay bales and brown soil, creating a momentary camouflage.

At an urban intersection under an overcast sky, a matte brown sedan waits at the traffic light, its hue matching the wet brown brick office building behind it, the scene further softened by the low reflectivity index typical for this color.

In moderate city traffic, a brown delivery van with identical earthy tones to the fallen leaves scattered on the road navigates the lane ahead, the common cargo vehicle appearing almost as part of the autumn streetscape.

From the dashcam view on a rural highway at dusk, a brown pickup truck with mud-splattered sides emerges from a gravel service road, its earth tone level high enough to have camouflaged it among the dry brush and brown hillocks until now.

The vehicle approaches a railway crossing where a brown school bus is stopped, its earthy paint blending with the brown autumn trees and fields in the background, the scene displaying typical cargo vehicle commonality in rural settings.

In an industrial zone, a flatbed truck carrying brown shipping containers partially blocks the intersection; the low reflectivity of the brown metal surfaces causes them to appear almost black in the shadow of a warehouse, reducing early detection.

On a winding gravel road through drought-affected hills, a brown SUV with a high earth tone level drives ahead, its color so well camouflaged among the dry bushes and brown terrain that it remains difficult to distinguish from the landscape without active taillights.

name: Maroon
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: In the left lane of a bustling urban avenue, a maroon luxury SUV with a glossy finish stands out against the gray asphalt, its rich deep hue catching the afternoon sunlight.
Driving through a residential neighborhood at dusk, a parked maroon coupe on the curb becomes increasingly difficult to discern from the brown brick house behind it as the light fades.
On a foggy morning highway, the rare sight of a maroon-colored hatchback ahead momentarily draws attention before blending back into the muted surroundings.
At a poorly lit intersection after dark, only the reflective trim of a maroon sedan is visible initially, its dark red body nearly invisible against the night until it moves into the headlight beam.
From the driver's seat, scanning the multi-lane roundabout during rush hour, a deep maroon compact car emerges from the traffic flow, its color giving it an understated yet premium presence.
Approaching a toll plaza on the expressway, a maroon luxury saloon with tinted windows occupies the ETC lane, its dark wine-red paint job signaling rarity amid the silver and white vehicles.

In slow-moving evening traffic on a wet city street, the taillight reflections smear against a maroon van in the adjacent lane, making its rear profile harder to gauge due to the low contrast with the damp road.
While navigating a steep mountain road under overcast skies, a maroon off-road vehicle negotiating a sharp turn ahead almost fades into the shadowy rock face, its deep tone reducing early visibility.

name: Purple
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: In midday on a busy downtown street, a glossy purple sedan stands out among the sea of white and silver cars as I slow down for a red light.
Night driving on an unlit rural road, I barely notice a dark purple vehicle parked on the shoulder without hazard lights until my headlights catch its rear reflectors at the last moment.
Through the windshield, I see a pride parade float decorated with huge purple ribbons and balloons crossing a major intersection, causing all traffic to halt.
Checking my side mirror before changing lanes on the expressway, I spot a FedEx delivery truck with its distinctive purple and orange logo rapidly approaching from behind.
Thick fog reduces visibility to a few car lengths, and ahead I can just make out the faint purple glow of a car's LED daytime running lights before seeing the vehicle itself.
While driving through a suburban neighborhood, a bright purple pickup truck with oversized wheels and a loud exhaust merges aggressively in front of me, hard to miss.
At dusk with a purple-orange sky reflected on the wet asphalt, a purple car ahead almost disappears into the colorful glare until I'm dangerously close.
In a slow-moving funeral procession, the lead hearse is adorned with purple flower arrangements, and the cars behind follow with purple flags attached to their antennas.

name: Dark
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: Driving on an unlit rural road on a moonless night, the luminance drops below 0.05 cd/m², the high beams barely light up the dark asphalt; the low contrast with heavily worn road markings forces reliance on road edges, while a deer's dark coat perfectly conceals it until it steps into the beam.

Creeping through a dimly lit residential area after a power outage, the street is almost pitch black with only the car’s headlights providing 15 meters of visibility; the dark road surface, still radiating absorbed heat from the day, creates a slight shimmer, and a pedestrian in dark clothing emerges from behind a parked car with near-zero contrast.

On a nocturnal highway, the dark pavement contrasts sharply with the brightly reflective lane markings, the scene luminance around 1 cd/m² from distant traffic; an unlit broken-down vehicle on the shoulder is nearly invisible due to its dark color and low night concealment level.

Entering a tunnel during daylight, the sudden transition to 10 cd/m² darkness reveals a poorly lit interior; the dark road surface and insufficiently contrasted markings make it hard to judge lane position, while the heat absorption of the asphalt causes a subtle temperature rise inside the tunnel.

At nautical twilight with heavy overcast, the sky offers no light, leaving the road in a uniform 0.3 cd/m² darkness; the streetlights flicker on late, so the dark road surface shows only faint markings, and a cyclist without lights wearing a dark jacket blends into the shadowy background.

Scanning a vast, unlit parking structure at 1 a.m., luminance hovers around 0.1 cd/m² from the car’s own headlights; dark-colored vehicles are camouflaged, and the low contrast with the grimy concrete floor conceals a speed bump until the jolt.

After a summer thunderstorm at midnight, the wet dark asphalt mirrors the few streetlights, cutting contrast with road markings to almost nothing; the day’s absorbed heat has dissipated into the rain-cooled night, yet the deep darkness still hides a flooded pothole until the splash.

Negotiating a forested mountain pass under starlight, the road luminance barely reaches 0.02 cd/m² between tree shadows; the dark asphalt, having absorbed intense sunlight during the day, releases a faint thermal glow, but the thick night concealment makes a fallen log indistinguishable from the pavement until dangerously close.

name: Golden
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: On a bustling urban avenue during golden hour, the setting sun casts a warm golden glow across the road, highlighting the deep metallic yellow paint of a luxury sedan in the adjacent lane.
While merging onto the highway at midday, a car with a bright golden reflective wrap overtakes from the left, its body gleaming brilliantly under the direct sunlight.
Negotiating a narrow suburban street at dusk, the vehicle's headlights illuminate a parked golden-colored sports car, its metallic finish radiating a rich, deep luster.
Driving through a financial district in the afternoon, the camera captures a golden Rolls-Royce stopped ahead at a crosswalk, its highly reflective gold bodywork unmistakably projecting opulence.
At a multi-lane intersection during light rain, a golden yellow taxi with high reflectivity waits for the green light, droplets beading on its metallic surface.
Traveling on a rural road in the early morning, the low sun catches a distant vehicle's golden trim, causing a brief, intense glare in the front-facing camera.

In heavy evening traffic on an urban expressway, a sleek coupe in a deep metallic gold paint job repeatedly changes lanes, its luxury association evident as it shimmers under overhead LED streetlights.

Approaching a mountain tunnel exit on a sunny day, the camera momentarily blinds as it records a golden road sign with high reflectivity, its metallic yellow depth standing out against the dark tunnel interior.

name: Taupe
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: The taupe-colored sedan ahead merges smoothly into the left lane on a busy downtown street, its low-profile hue blending with the overcast sky.
Driving along a dusty gravel road, the taupe dust kicked up by the vehicle ahead coats the windshield, reducing visibility to mere meters.
In the suburban mall parking lot, a taupe SUV stands out subtly among the sea of white and black cars, its neutral tone matching the concrete pillars.
On the interstate at dusk, a taupe camouflage-patterned pickup truck cruises in the right lane, almost disappearing against the arid roadside brush.
Winding through a mountain pass, the guardrail on the left is painted a muted taupe, blending seamlessly with the rocky cliff face, but the reflectors still catch the headlights.
Approaching a roadwork area, a taupe temporary barrier channels traffic into a single lane, its color reminiscent of dry earth and unnoticed by many drivers until close.
A taupe-colored house with a matching fence lines a quiet suburban street, the car's side mirror barely distinguishing the curb from the neutral-toned landscape in the low morning light.
In heavy fog, the taupe silhouette of a slow-moving garbage truck looms ahead, its color making it a near-invisible obstacle until the rear lights flicker.

name: Orange
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: Ahead on this two-lane city street, a row of bright orange traffic cones with white reflective collars funnels traffic into the right lane, while construction workers in vivid orange safety vests stand next to a temporary orange 'Road Work Ahead' sign under midday sun.

On a night highway drive, the left shoulder is marked by a series of orange traffic cones leading to a maintenance truck with a flashing amber/orange beacon; vehicles in all lanes slow to a cautious 30 mph.

At a busy intersection during the afternoon rush, a traffic control officer in a highly visible orange safety vest directs vehicles with a STOP paddle whose border reflects intense orange, while several sedans and an SUV wait their turn.

Navigating a winding mountain pass in early morning light, the road narrows due to rockfall repair; large orange plastic barriers and a reflective orange 'Max Speed 20' sign guide my path among sparse traffic.

Approaching a school zone on a quiet suburban road, I see a crossing guard in a fluorescent orange vest with silver reflective stripes stopping traffic, as orange cones with 'SCHOOL' markings channel children across the crosswalk.

In moderate rain on a city avenue, an open utility hole is encircled by blinking orange warning lights and striped orange-and-white barricades; two workers in water‑repellent orange coveralls and hard hats operate a winch, with cars forced to merge left.

Cruising in the center lane of a six‑lane interstate in the afternoon, I notice a row of tall, vibrant orange construction barrels delineating a lane closure ahead, and an overhead electronic sign displays 'STEADY ORANGE — SPEED 45 MPH'.

On a lonely rural two-lane road at dawn, a diamond‑shaped 'Construction Ahead' sign with an orange‑colored background and retroreflective edges glows in my low‑beam headlights, and a pickup truck approaches from the opposite direction.

name: Pink
desc: Visual color of vehicles, road elements, or environmental features.
extend_desc: Cruising on the highway at dawn, the sky ahead is painted in soft shades of pink, with streaks of orange clouds above the horizon, and the road glistens with morning dew.
In dense city traffic, a vibrant pink compact car stands out in the adjacent lane, its glossy finish reflecting the afternoon sun, while surrounding vehicles are mostly white and gray.

Driving slowly through a residential neighborhood, the road is lined with cherry trees in full bloom, their pink petals fluttering down onto the windshield and pavement, creating a dreamy tunnel effect.
Approaching an intersection, a large pink billboard promoting a new floral perfume dominates the right side of the road, with pink petals and a model, contrasting against the gray overcast sky.
At evening rush hour, the setting sun casts a pinkish glow over the urban expressway; brake lights ahead blend with the warm hue, while the skyline reflects orange-pink clouds.
Navigating a commercial district at night, a retro diner’s pink neon sign buzzes above the sidewalk, casting a rosy reflection on the wet asphalt after a recent rain.

A temporary road work area is marked by bright pink traffic cones and barriers, guiding the vehicle to merge left; workers in high-visibility vests are present, and the cone color contrasts with the usual orange.
A cyclist wearing a neon pink jacket pedals along the bike lane ahead, making them highly visible against the green trees and gray road, as the vehicle maintains a safe following distance.

name: RoadType
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: The vehicle cruises on a multi-lane highway under clear skies, with solid white lane markings, overhead gantry signs, and metal guardrails on both sides.
Driving through an urban four-way intersection at dusk, the road has clear stop lines and crosswalks, with traffic lights suspended above and tall buildings lining the streets.
The car navigates a winding two-lane rural road with faded centerline markings, flanked by dense trees and occasional reflective guide posts.
Moving slowly through a residential area, the narrow two-way street lacks lane markings, with cars parked along the curb and speed bumps every hundred meters.
The vehicle descends a steep mountain road with sharp hairpin turns, protected by stout guardrails and marked by reflective warning signs on the cliff side.
Entering a well-lit tunnel, the two-lane road features bright lane markings and yellow cat’s eyes, with tiled walls and ceiling fans maintaining air flow.
Crossing a long bridge over a river, the roadway has expansion joints at intervals, solid side barriers, and electronic variable message signs displaying speed limits.
Approaching a roundabout on a sunny day, the vehicle yields to circulating traffic, guided by yield signs and chevron markings, with a landscaped central island.

name: RoadGeometry
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: The vehicle approaches a four-way urban intersection with clear directional arrows indicating left-turn and through lanes, a stop line before the crosswalk, and traffic lights overhead.
Driving on a winding mountain road, the narrow two-lane path snakes uphill with steep drop-offs guarded by metal barriers, and the center line is barely visible due to wear.
On a straight multi-lane highway, the dashed white lane markings and reflective road studs are clearly visible, while an overhead gantry displays speed limit signs for each lane.
In a residential neighborhood, the road narrows with cars parked along both sides, no center line marking, and a speed hump marked with white triangles ahead.
Entering a large roundabout, the vehicle follows the curved lane markings with arrows directing to specific exits, while the central island is filled with low bushes.
Crossing a long bridge, the road surface shows expansion joints, with metal guardrails on both sides and a view of water below; lane markings are solid white edges.
Inside a well-lit tunnel, the tiled walls reflect the vehicle's headlights, and overhead lane control signals display green arrows, while the road remains straight with solid lane lines.
Navigating a construction zone, the vehicle follows temporary lane markings as the road shifts left, delineated by orange cones and barriers, with a reduced speed limit sign visible.

name: RoadSurface
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: The asphalt road surface is dry and smooth, with two solid yellow center lines and scattered manhole covers visible, under bright sunlight.
Navigating a curved rural road with worn and faded lane markings, the surface showing signs of gravel and minor cracks, under overcast skies.
Highway road surface at night, illuminated by headlights, featuring reflective lane dividers and raised pavement markers, with a rumble strip on the right edge.
After a rain shower, the concrete road is wet and reflective, with clear white pedestrian crossing stripes and a left-turn arrow marking ahead at the intersection.
Driving slowly on a narrow cobblestone street in an old district, the uneven surface has no lane markings, only stone curbs lining the sides in daytime.
The road surface is broken with multiple potholes and patches, temporary orange lane markings redirect traffic, and orange cones line the construction zone.
A winter road covered with compacted snow, tire tracks form two dark lanes, and the underlying asphalt and lane markings are barely visible.
Crossing a bridge, the road surface consists of concrete slabs with metal expansion joints, enhanced with anti-skid texturing, guardrails on both sides, sunny afternoon.

name: LaneMarkings
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: On a three-lane highway under bright sunlight, the white dashed lane markings are crisp and freshly painted, while a solid yellow line separates the opposite direction on the left.
Driving through a dimly lit urban area at night, the worn and faded lane markings are only faintly visible in the headlight beams, making lane discipline tricky.
In heavy rain, the windshield wipers sweep water aside, revealing blurred lane lines, but the reflective road studs between lanes shine through and guide the way.
Entering a roadwork zone, orange temporary lane markings divert traffic from the original white lines, with plastic bollards reinforcing the new path ahead.
On a narrow rural road, there are no lane markings at all, only the edge of the asphalt meeting the gravel shoulder serves as a visual boundary.
Approaching a major intersection, the asphalt features bold white directional arrows — a left-turn arrow in one lane and a straight arrow in the adjacent lane, both freshly stenciled.
The rightmost lane begins a dotted line pattern that tapers into a deceleration lane, signaling an upcoming highway exit marked with a green sign reading Exit 42.
Thick fog shrouds the road, reducing visibility drastically; the lane markings emerge only a few meters ahead, and the vehicle relies on center-line reflector dots to maintain its lane.

name: RoadConditions
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: Driving on a dry, smooth asphalt highway with clear white lane markings and continuous guardrails on both sides under bright daylight.
At night, the vehicle moves along a wet urban road where faded lane lines are barely visible due to reflected streetlight glare and light rain.
On a dusty gravel rural road with no painted markings, the car bounces over potholes and loose stones, surrounded by open fields.
The plow hasn't cleared this suburban stretch yet; snow partially obscures lane markings, and a roadside sign warns of icy conditions ahead.
Navigating a steep downhill mountain road with tight hairpin curves, dense fog limits visibility, but orange guardrails and chevron signs guide the way.
Entering a construction zone on asphalt, the original markings are covered, replaced by temporary orange lines, with cones and concrete barriers narrowing the lane.
Sunset light casts long shadows across a cracked residential street with faded speed bumps and almost invisible lane paint.
Traveling on a freshly poured concrete road at night, no final markings are applied, but raised reflective pavement markers outline the lanes temporarily.

name: Shoulder
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: Driving on a rural two-lane road, the narrow gravel shoulder is overgrown with weeds, with no guardrails, and a dense forest looms beyond.
On a multi-lane highway, the wide paved shoulder is marked with a solid white line, and an emergency call box is visible ahead.
Navigating a suburban street at dusk, the curb-lined shoulder has parked cars, and a bicycle lies discarded near a storm drain.
The vehicle moves along a mountain road with a sheer cliff on the left, while on the right a narrow shoulder hugs the rock face, dotted with fallen rocks.
At night on an expressway, the vehicle's headlights illuminate a broken-down sedan on the shoulder, its hazard lights flashing.
During heavy rain, the highway shoulder is barely visible; water pools on the uneven asphalt, and the edge line is faded.
Driving past a construction zone, the shoulder is temporarily closed off with orange cones and a portable sign indicating 'Shoulder Work'.
On a clear morning commute, the wide left shoulder of an urban freeway is used by a stalled bus, while traffic flows slowly in the adjacent lane.

name: Median
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: Driving on a multi-lane highway, the vehicle passes a wide grassy median with a continuous steel guardrail in the center, clearly separating the opposing traffic streams.
The urban road ahead features a raised concrete median, painted with yellow and white stripes, topped with small shrubs and streetlights every few meters, as seen from the vehicle's front camera.
On a rural two-lane road, the vehicle approaches a flush median marked only by double solid yellow lines and occasional reflective pavement markers, with no physical barrier.
In heavy traffic, the vehicle cruises beside a tall concrete Jersey barrier median, which blocks the view of oncoming cars but reduces glare from headlights.
During nighttime driving, the median appears as a low hedge with embedded reflective delineators that glow in the headlights, separating the expressway lanes.
The vehicle travels on an expressway where the median consists of a sloped grassy strip and a w-beam guardrail on the far side, with sparse vegetation.
On a suburban avenue, the median is a raised planter filled with colorful flowers and a pedestrian refuge island, equipped with zebra-striped signposts and overhead lighting.
Passing through a roadwork zone, the temporary median is formed by interconnected water-filled barriers topped with orange cones and warning signs, narrowing the lane slightly.

name: Intersection
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: The vehicle approaches a four-way urban intersection on a clear day, with well-maintained lane markings, a green traffic light ahead, and a few vehicles waiting in adjacent lanes.
Driving on a narrow rural road, the car reaches a T-junction marked by a stop sign, the road markings are faded, and there is no traffic signal; a pickup truck from the right yields.
At night, the vehicle enters a large roundabout intersection with bright overhead lighting, multiple lanes with clear directional arrows, and moderate traffic circling.
The car navigates a construction zone at a city intersection, where original lane markings are covered and temporary orange lines guide the path alongside cones and barriers.
Approaching a major intersection with dedicated left-turn and right-turn lanes, the traffic light shows a red arrow for left turns while through lanes have a green signal.
In a quiet suburban neighborhood, the vehicle comes to an all-way stop intersection with a crosswalk, where a mother and child are currently crossing in front of the car.
The vehicle enters a school zone intersection with flashing yellow warning lights, a marked crosswalk with a crossing guard, and reduced speed limit signs posted.
Rain falls steadily as the car approaches a downtown intersection, the wet road surface reflects taillights, and faded lane markings make it difficult to discern turn lanes.

name: Bridge
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: The vehicle cruises steadily across a long reinforced concrete bridge spanning a wide river, with clear white lane markings, metallic guardrails on both sides, and a panoramic view of the city skyline under a bright afternoon sun.
At night, the car's headlights sweep over the wet asphalt of a steel arch bridge, streetlamps reflecting off the shiny surface, sparse traffic ahead, and cat's eye reflectors guiding the lane edges.

In a foggy early morning, the vehicle carefully inches over a narrow old stone bridge with low parapets, no lane markings, and a single lane barely wide enough for one car, the canal water barely visible below.

The autonomous vehicle merges onto a multi-lane urban overpass, the concrete structure bustling with dense traffic, overhead gantry signs displaying lane destinations, and sharp shadows cast by tall buildings in the bright sunlight.

The car passes beneath a massive bridge overpass, the camera capturing thick concrete pillars, a low clearance warning sign reflecting in the headlights, and the road narrowing briefly before opening up again.

Driving slowly into a historic wooden covered bridge, the vehicle's headlights illuminate the dark interior, the sound of tires on wooden planks echoing, with just enough width for a single lane and rain dripping from the eaves.

On a windy mountain pass, the vehicle crosses a suspension bridge with towering main cables, the long span causing a slight sway, narrow lanes with faded markings, and majestic snow-capped peaks in the distance.

In the middle of the night with no streetlights, the high beams of the car cut through the darkness over a remote bridge spanning a deep valley, the asphalt unmarked and the rickety metal guardrails just visible at the edges.

name: Tunnel
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: Driving through a long highway tunnel with bright overhead lights, the lane markings are clearly visible as the vehicle maintains a steady speed, while a truck ahead moves slowly in the right lane.
The vehicle enters a curved mountain tunnel at dusk, with dim yellow lighting along the walls and damp pavement reflecting faint light, making the faded lane markings hard to distinguish.
In a heavily congested urban underpass, the tunnel ceiling is low and lined with grimy tiles; the car crawls forward amid dense traffic, with the sound of engines echoing.
At night, the tunnel's bright white LED lights create a contrast with the darkness outside; reflective lane dots guide the path as the autonomous vehicle adapts its headlights.
A modern tunnel equipped with dynamic message signs displays speed advisories; the entrance is marked by red and green traffic lights, currently showing green for our lane.
Emerging from the tunnel's exit, bright sunlight temporarily blinds the vision; the lane markings transition from solid white to dashed, and an emergency pull-off area is visible on the right.
Inside a narrow, curved tunnel with no shoulder, the proximity warning sensors beep as a large truck passes in the opposite direction, its roar magnified by the confined space.
The journey through an undersea tunnel is monotonous, with fluorescent tubes evenly spaced on the ceiling; the road surface is dry but stained with tire marks, and traffic is sparse.

name: RoadAttribute
desc: Physical characteristics and conditions of the roadway.
extend_desc: The car descends a long, steep downhill road stretching over 200 meters; the slope is so pronounced that engine braking alone isn't enough, and I have to intermittently tap the brakes to keep the speed under 40 km/h, with a sheer drop on the right side adding to the tension.

After the rain, the two-lane rural road ahead is covered in a thin, reflective layer of water; the surface feels slick at even 50 km/h, and the tire spray from the truck in front reduces visibility, forcing me to increase following distance.

A sharp hairpin bend lies ahead, its intensity rated at 5 in the navigation warning; the curve radius is so tight that the lane appears to vanish into the mountainside, and the 150-meter stretch requires a full stop and a cautious 15 km/h entry.

In this narrow alley, the road width is barely 2.5 meters, with high brick walls on both sides; any oncoming vehicle would mean reversing for a long 300-meter segment, so I creep forward listening for engines.

A fresh crack in the asphalt runs diagonally across the lane, with a depth that could damage the wheel; just ahead, a series of potholes extend for about 40 meters, forcing me to zigzag gently to avoid them.

The white lane markings on this aging highway are so faded that they're barely visible under the midday sun; over the next 2 kilometers, I have to rely on the road's edge line and the position of other cars to stay centered.

Entering the tunnel, the abrupt darkness contrasts with bright daylight; the first 100 meters are unpainted rough concrete, causing the car to jolt, and my vision takes a few seconds to adjust, prompting me to slow to 30 km/h.

A steep uphill climb begins here, with an estimated duration of 2 minutes at this grade; the lane markings are yellow, and the road surface is slightly sandy from construction, causing wheelspin if I accelerate too hard.

name: Highway
desc: Functional classification of the roadway.
extend_desc: Traveling in the middle lane of a four-lane highway, the speed limit sign indicates 120 km/h, with a clear emergency lane on the right. The entrance and exit density is moderate, and a gantry sign displays the next service station 20 kilometers ahead. Light traffic flows smoothly under clear daytime conditions.

Driving on a two-lane highway with a speed limit of 100 km/h, the roadside offers only a narrow hard shoulder without a dedicated emergency lane. Sparse ramps mean long stretches without exits, and the next service station is 50 kilometers away. A truck ahead occupies the right lane at dusk with lights on.

The vehicle crawls along a congested three-lane highway during morning rush hour, with a posted 110 km/h limit but actual speed below 30 km/h. An emergency lane is present to the right, while entrance and exit ramps appear every kilometer in this urban expressway segment. The last service station was passed five kilometers ago.

In heavy rain, the wipers work at high speed on a two-lane-per-direction highway where the speed limit drops to 80 km/h due to mountainous terrain. The emergency lane is narrow but usable, exits are infrequent, and the next service station is 30 kilometers ahead.

Cruising at night on an almost empty five-lane expressway with a 120 km/h limit, the emergency lane runs continuously on the right shoulder. The rural stretch has very few entrances or exits, and an overhead sign informs that the next service station is 60 kilometers away.

The highway is reduced to a single lane due to roadworks, with a temporary 60 km/h speed limit and no emergency lane—only traffic cones separating the work zone. Construction vehicles frequently merge from the closed section, and the next rest area is 15 kilometers down the road.

Variable message signs overhead show a current speed limit of 100 km/h on a three-lane highway, while the standard limit is 130 km/h. An emergency lane is available, and interchanges appear at medium intervals. Wisps of fog drift across the carriageway at dawn, and the next service station is 25 kilometers ahead.

From the left lane of a two-lane highway with a 110 km/h limit, a broken-down car is visible on the wide emergency lane ahead with hazard lights flashing. Exits are sparse along this rural section, and the last service station was passed 10 kilometers ago. Traffic gradually slows in response.

name: UrbanRoad
desc: Functional classification of the roadway.
extend_desc: Driving along a six-lane urban boulevard with a 50 km/h speed limit, the road is lined with numerous intersections and pedestrian crosswalks, and a dedicated bus lane is clearly marked on the right side.

The vehicle moves slowly on a narrow two-lane city street with a posted 30 km/h limit, passing through a residential area with few intersections but frequent zebra crossings, and no bus lane in sight.

Cruising on a four-lane arterial road at 60 km/h, the onboard camera captures sparse crosswalks and occasional traffic lights, while a solid white line separates a dedicated bus lane on the far right.
A dense urban corridor unfolds ahead: multiple lanes, 40 km/h speed limit, constant intersections, painted crosswalks at every block, and buses stopping in their own lane to the right of the vehicle.
From the driver's perspective, this urban road has only two lanes, a 30 km/h limit, low intersection density, yet crosswalks appear frequently near a school zone, and there is no bus lane.

Navigating a busy urban thoroughfare with four lanes and a 70 km/h limit, the road features widely spaced intersections, minimal crosswalks, and a designated bus lane intermittently marked by dashed lines.

The vehicle proceeds on a four-lane road where the speed limit drops to 40 km/h, encountering a high density of signaled intersections and abundant crosswalks, while buses overtake in the adjacent lane.
A one-way urban street with a 25 km/h limit presents a single lane flanked by parked cars, frequent alleys intersecting, pedestrians crossing at every corner, and no room for a bus lane.

name: RuralRoad
desc: Functional classification of the roadway.
extend_desc: The vehicle travels along a narrow single-lane rural road with a posted speed limit of 30 km/h, winding through dense curves and lacking any paved shoulder under bright midday sun.
A two-lane rural road stretches ahead under an overcast sky, with a 60 km/h speed limit, moderate curve density, and a narrow gravel shoulder providing minimal refuge.
On a wide two-lane rural highway with a 90 km/h speed limit, the straight road offers excellent visibility and a paved shoulder, bathed in strong daylight.
Dusk falls as the vehicle navigates a tight-curving single-lane rural road, speed limited to 25 km/h, with only a crumbling dirt shoulder for emergency stops.
In total darkness, headlights illuminate an unpaved rural track with no lane markings, a 20 km/h practical speed, and no shoulder, bordered by overgrown grass.
The car follows a moderately curved rural road with a speed limit of 50 km/h, passing through tree-lined stretches; a narrow but paved shoulder appears sporadically in the afternoon light.
A four-lane divided rural expressway allows speeds up to 110 km/h, with gentle curves, wide paved shoulders, and clear visibility in the early morning haze.
Fog reduces visibility on a winding single-lane rural road with no lane markings, a 15 km/h advisory speed, and only a soft grass verge, as the vehicle inches forward.

name: ResidentialRoad
desc: Functional classification of the roadway.
extend_desc: The ego vehicle cautiously navigates a narrow residential street with a 20 km/h speed limit, where cars are parked densely on both sides, and a child on a bicycle is visible ahead near a speed bump.
Driving along a two-lane residential road, speed limit 30 km/h, with moderate roadside parking; a speed hump appears every 100 meters, and no pedestrians are in sight.
A wide residential boulevard with a dedicated bike lane, speed limit 40 km/h, sparse parking in driveways, several families strolling on the sidewalk, and no speed bumps present.
Approaching the end of a cul-de-sac in a residential area, speed limit 25 km/h, children playing basketball near the curb, and a speed bump installed at the entrance.

At dusk, the vehicle traverses a tree-lined residential road with a 25 km/h limit, parked cars partially obscuring the view, and an occasional speed hump as a child on a scooter crosses the street ahead.
Entering a school zone on a residential street, speed limit 20 km/h, cars parked heavily along both sides, a crossing guard assisting children, and speed tables near the crosswalk.
Moving through a one-way narrow residential alley, speed limit 15 km/h, vehicles parked only on the left side, no children but a dog on a leash, and speed bumps at each intersection.
Cruising on a suburban residential road with two wide lanes, speed limit 30 km/h, few cars parked on the street, children playing in a front yard, and speed bumps positioned before each intersection.

name: ServiceRoad
desc: Functional classification of the roadway.
extend_desc: The vehicle is traveling on a service road adjacent to the highway, with several gas stations and fast-food restaurants on the right, and a temporary parking area with a few trucks ahead.
In an urban area, the service road runs parallel to a busy main road; the entrance to a shopping center appears on the left, while vehicles are parked temporarily along the curb.
At dusk, the car moves slowly on a service road near a rest area, with multiple exits leading back onto the expressway and a sign indicating a truck parking zone.
Through the windshield, the service road ahead is narrow and lined with parked cars, with only one exit merging into the main road; a delivery van is unloading on the left.
Driving on a service road in a commercial district, the view shows a row of shops with two entrances to the main road, and a temporary parking area occupied by a taxi.
The autonomous vehicle navigates a service road at night, passing a brightly lit gas station, with no temporary parking spots visible and a single entrance ramp to the highway.
From the onboard camera, the service road curves gently alongside the main road; a rest stop with picnic tables appears, and there are multiple entrances for local traffic.
On a rainy day, the vehicle cruises on a service road with reduced visibility; a temporary parking area is filled with trucks, and the exit to the freeway is just ahead.

name: Parking
desc: Functional classification of the roadway.
extend_desc: The autonomous vehicle cruises through a large outdoor parking lot adjacent to a shopping mall, with numerous standard-sized spaces visible on both sides, and an overhead digital sign indicates 15 available spots in row C.

Inside a multi-story parking structure, the vehicle ascends a ramp with compact parking bays on each side; above each bay a light shows red for occupied, green for available, and a display at the end of the aisle flashes 'Level 3: 4 spaces left'.

Navigating through a dimly lit underground parking garage, the headlights illuminate a row of EV charging stations ahead, each marked with a blue sign indicating payment via a mobile app, and only one bay is free next to a white sedan already plugged in.

The vehicle slowly passes a row of parallel parking spots along a busy city street; each spot is regulated by a parking meter displaying 'EXPIRED' or remaining time, and a red curb indicates no-parking zones, with only one small gap available ahead.

Approaching a supermarket entrance, the car enters a lot with wide, angled parking bays painted in bright white lines, each bay numbered; a large overhead canopy provides shade, and several shoppers load groceries into their cars nearby.

Pulling up to a fully automated parking facility, the driver is greeted by a touchscreen kiosk that instructs to leave the car at a designated drop-off zone; robotic arms will measure the vehicle and transport it to an available slot in the high-density storage racks.

Under a canopy of solar panels, the autonomous car identifies an available EV charging spot marked with green pavement markings; a nearby LED display reads 'Fast Charger, $0.35/kWh available' and the adjacent charger has a retracted cable ready for use.

The vehicle cautiously navigates a makeshift gravel parking area used as overflow, with no painted lines; a few scattered cars are parked haphazardly, and a hand-written sign on a fence says 'Free Parking, Park at Your Own Risk'.

name: Straight
desc: Horizontal and vertical shape of the road, including curves and slopes.
extend_desc: The ego vehicle is cruising on a straight, level highway in clear weather; the road has a standard crown for drainage, and light traffic is distributed across three lanes.
A long straight rural road stretches ahead with a moderate uphill gradient, the pavement has a slight transverse slope towards the shoulder, and a truck is slowly climbing in the right lane.
Driving through an urban area at night, the straight avenue has a gentle downhill slope and a pronounced crown that channels water to the curbs, with oncoming vehicles' headlights creating glare.
The vehicle descends a straight, steep grade on a mountain highway, with the road's transverse slope aiding water runoff, and the brake lights of vehicles ahead are visible in the twilight.
On a straight bridge segment, the road surface has no crossfall, offering a perfectly flat transverse profile, and the vehicle passes between tall guardrails with a river below.

The road ahead is perfectly straight with a very slight longitudinal slope, barely noticeable; it is flanked by dense trees, and the late afternoon sun creates long shadows, but no other vehicles are present.
A straight multi-lane arterial road in the suburbs has a continuous slight uphill gradient and a normal crown; heavy traffic is moving steadily, with stop-and-go conditions starting further up.

Traveling along a straight stretch of highway in a heavy downpour, the road’s transverse slope effectively channels water to the edges, and the windshield wipers are at maximum speed while maintaining a safe following distance behind a semi-truck.

name: Curved
desc: Horizontal and vertical shape of the road, including curves and slopes.
extend_desc: The vehicle navigates a sharp right-hand curve on a mountain highway, with a small curvature radius of approximately 30 meters and a steep downhill gradient of 8%, while the road superelevation tilts inward to counteract centrifugal force, and the transverse slope is noticeable.

Driving through a gentle left-bending curve on a suburban arterial during evening rush hour, the curvature radius is large at around 300 meters, the longitudinal slope is nearly flat, and the road has minimal superelevation, with moderate traffic of sedans and SUVs ahead.

On a rainy night, the ego vehicle approaches a moderate right-hand curve on a two-lane rural road, with a curvature radius of about 80 meters and a slight uphill gradient of 3%, while the road surface shows high superelevation and water pooling in the outer lane.

A tight S-curve on a downhill mountain pass with a curvature radius as low as 20 meters at the apex, a longitudinal slope of -10% (steep descent), and a pronounced superelevation, while an oncoming truck takes the curve cautiously in the opposite lane.

The car enters a long sweeping right curve on a multi-lane expressway at midday, with a curvature radius exceeding 500 meters, the longitudinal slope is almost imperceptible (0.5% uphill), and the road superelevation is gentle, with sparse traffic across three lanes.

Navigating a medium left-hand curve on a city street with tram tracks, the curvature radius measures around 60 meters, the road has a minor downhill slope of 2%, and the superelevation is moderate, but the transverse slope is complicated by the tram groove, with cyclists on the right side.

A sharp hairpin turn to the right on a narrow mountain road with a curvature radius of only 15 meters, a steep uphill gradient of 12%, and extreme superelevation to prevent rollover, while the vehicle's sensor detects loose gravel on the outer edge of the curve.

On a foggy morning, the vehicle follows a winding road through a forest with alternating left and right curves, each having a curvature radius around 50 meters, minimal longitudinal slope changes, and varying superelevations, while traffic is light with only a slow-moving truck ahead.

name: Wide
desc: Horizontal and vertical shape of the road, including curves and slopes.
extend_desc: The vehicle travels along an extremely wide six-lane highway, the road surface exhibits a subtle crown for drainage, and the terrain is flat with no longitudinal slope, straight alignment visible for miles.
Ahead, a wide four-lane urban boulevard curves gently left; the road superelevation tilts the vehicle slightly outward, and the transverse slope helps channel rainwater on this misty evening.
The mountain expressway is unexpectedly wide with three lanes ascending a long uphill longitudinal slope; the road curves to the right with noticeable banking, and the curvature radius is moderate.
Looking forward from the windshield, a wide arterial road stretches straight with a mild uphill grade, the transverse slope barely perceptible, under the bright midday sun.

The camera captures a wide highway transitioning through a crest vertical curve; the road ahead momentarily disappears, then a sweeping right curve with a radius of about 800 meters comes into view, and the superelevation is built up.

The vehicle descends a wide, steep downhill roadway; the longitudinal slope is steep at about 6% grade, while the transverse slope remains consistent for drainage, and the road curves gently through a wide radius bend.

In the darkness, the headlights illuminate a wide suburban road with two lanes each way, the road surface is flat across with minimal camber, and there is no perceptible slope as it runs through a plain.

From the driver's perspective, a wide two-lane highway winds down a hill; the tight curve ahead is superelevated steeply, the longitudinal slope is a steady descent, and the road's width provides a safety margin.

name: Narrow
desc: Horizontal and vertical shape of the road, including curves and slopes.
extend_desc: Driving on a narrow country lane with tight switchbacks and a noticeable bank through the curves, climbing a moderate incline during late afternoon.
Navigating a narrow residential alley at night, the road surface has a steep cross slope towards the gutter, with cars parked tightly on both sides, leaving just enough width to pass.

The vehicle descends a narrow, steep mountain road with a sharp hairpin bend; the curvature radius is very tight, and there's no superelevation, causing a pronounced lateral tilt of the camera view as the car leans into the turn.

The dashcam captures a narrow asphalt road through a dense forest; the road has long, sweeping curves with a radius of over 200 meters, subtle banking on bends, and a nearly level longitudinal profile.
Exiting a highway onto a narrow single-lane ramp, the roadway is sharply banked with a tight 50-meter radius curve and a steep 6% downhill grade, as seen from the front-facing camera.

The car approaches a narrow stone bridge on an uphill incline, the road surface has minimal cross fall, and the single lane is just wide enough for the vehicle, with guardrails on both sides; the dashcam view shows the steep climb ahead.

Driving through a narrow tunnel with lighting, the road has a gentle downhill slope and a slight camber towards the edges; the lane is tight with concrete walls close on either side, captured from the vehicle's front camera.

The vehicle traverses a narrow, icy rural road as it crests a hill; the convex vertical curve limits forward visibility, and the road has a slight adverse superelevation on the following curve, challenging traction.

name: Slight
desc: Horizontal and vertical shape of the road, including curves and slopes.
extend_desc: On a gently curving highway segment with a large curvature radius of over 800 meters, the vehicle cruises at 100 km/h in the right lane during midday, with sparse traffic and clear visibility, and the road's slight superelevation is barely perceptible through the steering angle.

Approaching a slight uphill slope on a suburban two-lane road, the longitudinal gradient is about 3%, causing a minor power increase; a sedan ahead is maintaining speed while oncoming traffic passes smoothly under overcast afternoon light.

Driving down a mild downhill stretch with a 2° slope angle just before dusk, the vehicle's regenerative braking engages gently, and the road features a subtle transverse slope for water runoff, with streetlights beginning to illuminate the edge lines.

Navigating a slight right-hand curve on an urban expressway at night, the banked superelevation of 4% stabilizes the vehicle at 70 km/h, while the headlights reveal clear lane markings and reflective cat's eyes curving ahead.

During a drizzle on a rural road, a combination of a slight longitudinal downhill slope and a mild transverse crown channels rainwater to the shoulders, requiring smooth throttle modulation to maintain traction at moderate speed.

In a quiet residential zone, the vehicle traverses a slight bend with a curvature radius around 300 meters at low speed, noticing speed bumps immediately after the curve and a parked car partially blocking the lane view on a sunny morning.

Climbing a gentle mountain pass with a slope angle of only 2.5°, the road exhibits slight superelevation in the sweeping curves, and sturdy guardrails reflect the midday sun while the engine note rises subtly on the incline.

Traveling on a multi-lane freeway during rush hour, the slight transverse slope from the road crown is noticeable as the vehicle changes lanes gradually; dense traffic flows at 80 km/h, with the curve ahead having a radius so large it feels almost straight.

name: Dry
desc: Physical condition and texture of the road surface.
extend_desc: Driving on a multi-lane highway under bright sunlight, the asphalt road surface is completely dry with no visible moisture or dust, tire grip feels firm and responsive, temperature is around 30°C.

The narrow country road is dry and uneven, with a thin layer of dust kicked up by occasional passing tractors; the afternoon temperature is about 20°C and the friction appears slightly reduced near dusty patches.

Navigating through a city street on a dry autumn day, the road surface is hard and grippy despite a fine layer of dust from construction nearby; the elapsed time since last rain is over two weeks, and the temperature is 15°C.

Crossing a long bridge early morning, the concrete pavement is dry and the vehicle's tires produce a steady hum; with temperature at 2°C and no precipitation, the estimated friction coefficient remains normal, but caution is advised for shaded areas.

After a brief morning drizzle, the suburban road is now dry under the midday sun, the surface shows no puddles and the friction is restored to high levels; only a few wet-looking spots under trees evaporate rapidly at 25°C.

The vehicle travels along a dry gravel track, raising a cloud of dust behind; the surface is loose with stones, providing moderate grip at best, and the outside temperature reads 38°C, with no recent rain for months.

Cruising on the freeway after midnight, the road is dry and smooth, reflecting streetlights evenly; the friction coefficient is high, temperature around 10°C, and the elapsed time since last rain is a few days.

Maneuvering in a large open-air parking lot under scorching sun, the surface is dry but scattered with patches of fine dust and oil drips; tire grip varies noticeably, temperature above 35°C and no rain for weeks.

name: Wet
desc: Physical condition and texture of the road surface.
extend_desc: The urban street is covered by a thin layer of water after a recent shower, reflecting the cloudy sky and surrounding buildings. The road surface appears dark and glossy, with moderate slipperiness, and a car ahead leaves faint tire tracks on the wet asphalt.

Driving on a highway at dusk, heavy rain has left puddles up to 10 mm deep in the wheel ruts. Water mist sprays from the trucks in adjacent lanes, significantly reducing visibility, while the road's reflection of taillights creates a dazzling glare.

On a narrow rural road, numerous potholes are filled with muddy water, making it difficult to judge depth. The uneven surface feels extremely slippery, and the car's tires occasionally lose grip, kicking up splashes of water.

After a sudden downpour, a major intersection is flooded with up to 30 mm of standing water. Vehicles ahead create high splashes, and the road's reduced friction coefficient forces careful braking to avoid skidding on the slick surface.

Entering a tunnel during a rainstorm, the transition zone shows standing water near the entrance. The tunnel lights reflect sharply off the wet pavement, and tire spray from a bus in front generates a dense mist, narrowing the field of view.

An early morning drive on a suburban road: a mix of dew and light drizzle has formed a uniform water film barely 2 mm deep. The low sun directly ahead creates intense reflections, making lane markings almost invisible under the glare.

Winding through a mountainous area in persistent rain, water streams across the road, carrying gravel. The constant wetness has polished the asphalt to a slippery glaze, and mist rises from the valley, further limiting sight distance and traction.

Moving through congested urban traffic after a thunderstorm, water accumulates in ruts up to 15 mm deep. A large truck ahead throws a curtain of spray, saturating the windshield, while the road's reflective surface amplifies brake lights, requiring careful speed control to maintain adequate stopping distance.

name: Icy
desc: Physical condition and texture of the road surface.
extend_desc: The vehicle is crossing an overpass bridge in the early morning, where a thin layer of black ice coats the asphalt almost invisibly; the dashboard indicates an outside temperature of -2°C, and despite light braking, the traction control light flickers as the tires lose grip momentarily.

On a rural two-lane road under a gray sky, the surface is covered with compacted white ice at least 10 mm thick, with sand scattered toward the shoulders; the temperature reads -10°C, and the car crawls at 30 km/h with every steering input feeling sluggish and unresponsive.

Driving along a busy urban freeway during morning rush hour, the pavement glistens with melted ice and residual salt treatment, forming a slushy mix; the external sensor shows 0°C, and the vehicle maintains a safe distance from the truck ahead, feeling slight wheel spin when changing lanes.

Approaching a city intersection, the brake pedal pulses as the anti-lock system engages on a rutted white ice surface; the temperature is -5°C, and the car ahead fishtails slightly before coming to a stop at the red light, while my tires crunch over frozen ridges.

Merging onto a freeway ramp, the road appears wet but is actually glazed with transparent black ice; at -3°C, the rear end suddenly steps out during moderate acceleration, and the stability control intervenes while the steering wheel lightens in my hands.

Navigating a winding mountain pass, the lane is partially covered with thick ice patches despite recent sand application; the thermometer shows -8°C, and a snowplow sprays salt and sand in the opposite lane as I keep a steady 20 km/h, feeling the tires slide over polished ice in the shadows.

Exiting a shopping center parking lot onto a side street, the wheels spin on a patch of thin black ice hidden beneath a dusting of snow; the temperature has just dipped to -1°C, and the vehicle takes a moment to find traction as pedestrians carefully watch from the sidewalk.

Cruising through a suburban neighborhood at midnight, the road is a solid sheet of white ice, completely untreated and reflecting the headlights of an oncoming car; the temperature has plummeted to -12°C, making the ice diamond-hard, and even gentle throttle inputs cause the drive wheels to break loose momentarily.

name: Snowy
desc: Physical condition and texture of the road surface.
extend_desc: The vehicle travels on a rural two-lane road blanketed with a thick layer of fresh powder snow, the surface untracked except for faint, shallow ruts ahead, requiring cautious steering to maintain traction.

On a city street after a heavy snowfall, the road is covered with compacted wet snow, showing deep tire grooves filled with slush, and the car's tires occasionally slip when accelerating from a stoplight.

Driving along a highway at dusk, the asphalt is obscured by a uniform, thin layer of wind-packed snow, the surface smooth and icy with a low friction coefficient, causing the vehicle to glide slightly when changing lanes.

The vehicle navigates a mountain pass where the road surface is unevenly covered with packed snow and patches of exposed ice; the ruts from previous vehicles provide some guidance but the steering feels light due to reduced friction.

In a suburban neighborhood, the road is coated with several centimeters of wet snow that has been partially plowed, leaving a messy mix of slush and compacted ridges; the vehicle's wheels spin briefly when starting from a stop sign.

On an expressway during a snowstorm, the lane markings are invisible beneath a continuous blanket of fresh powder snow about 5 cm deep, and the car maintains a slow speed as the tires sink slightly, creating new tracks.

A car creeps forward on an unsalted side street covered with hardened, crusty snow that has been compacted by traffic, the uneven surface causing a bumpy ride, while the friction is sufficient for careful braking.

The vehicle approaches an intersection where the snowy road surface has transformed into polished ice with a friction coefficient as low as 0.1, forcing the driver to apply gentle braking well in advance to avoid sliding through the stop line.

name: Muddy
desc: Physical condition and texture of the road surface.
extend_desc: The vehicle-mounted camera shows a narrow country road covered with a thin layer of mud after a drizzle; the surface is slightly slippery but still passable at low speed.

Driving through a construction site, the front camera captures deep mud about 15 cm thick, with visible wheel ruts and a truck ahead struggling for traction, indicating high slipperiness and reduced adhesion.
At night, the headlights illuminate a muddy unpaved path full of water-filled potholes; the mud depth varies around 5-8 cm, and the vehicle experiences mild wheelspin.
On an off-road forest trail, the tires sink into thick mud over 20 cm deep, causing severe loss of grip and a high risk of getting stuck; only specialized vehicles could pass.
In the dusk light, a farm access road presents a heavily rutted muddy surface with tractor tire impressions; the mud is about 10 cm deep, moderately slippery but passable with careful steering.
In an urban area, a segment of the road near a construction entrance is covered with slick mud splattered across the asphalt, causing a sudden drop in traction and a high risk of skidding.
After a downpour, the unpaved village road has turned into a quagmire with mud depth exceeding 15 cm; a sedan ahead is bogged down, blocking the lane and making passage impossible without assistance.

Navigating a mountain pass, the camera shows a slide area where deep mud mixed with debris covers half the road; the surface is extremely slick and adhesion is near zero, rendering the route impassable.

name: Potholes
desc: Physical condition and texture of the road surface.
extend_desc: A rural road under overcast skies shows a single large pothole directly ahead, approximately 40 cm in diameter and 10 cm deep, forcing the vehicle to slow down and carefully steer to the left to avoid it.

In heavy rain on a busy urban street, the vehicle encounters a cluster of numerous small potholes scattered across the lane, each around 15 cm wide and 5 cm deep, making smooth driving impossible as cars in adjacent lanes limit maneuvering space.

At sunset on a highway off-ramp, a series of deep potholes line the right side of the road, the largest measuring 50 cm across and 15 cm deep, creating a severe avoidance challenge with high-speed traffic approaching from behind.

During a sunny morning on a residential street, the driver notices a few shallow potholes near the curb, each about 20 cm in diameter and 3 cm deep, easily avoidable by slightly adjusting the vehicle's position within the lane.

On a narrow country lane at night, the headlights reveal a dense patch of potholes spanning the entire road width, with depths up to 12 cm and diameters reaching 30 cm, leaving the vehicle no choice but to proceed slowly and risk damage.

A commercial district road after a thunderstorm presents a scattered pattern of medium-sized potholes, roughly 25 cm wide and 8 cm deep, with moderate traffic allowing partial lane changes to dodge the worst ones.

On a gravel access road in a construction zone, a massive pothole approximately 60 cm in diameter and 20 cm deep dominates the path, surrounded by smaller cracks, forcing the vehicle to stop and carefully navigate around the edge.

In bright daylight on a multi-lane arterial road, intermittent potholes of varying sizes—from 10 cm to 35 cm wide—appear randomly across both lanes, with light traffic enabling the driver to weave between them with some difficulty.

name: Main
desc: Adjective attributes describing traffic or environmental state of the road.
extend_desc: Driving on a 4-lane main road during rush hour, traffic volume around 3000 vehicles per hour, speed limit 80 km/h, the road has priority over crossing streets with few interruptions, ensuring steady flow.

The vehicle moves along a main urban avenue with moderate traffic, speed limit 50 km/h, two lanes in each direction, approaching a traffic light at a busy intersection; the road's priority is regulated by signals.
Cruising on a suburban main road with light traffic, only a few cars nearby, a single lane in each direction, speed limit 60 km/h, with clear right-of-way over minor crossings marked by yield signs.
Nighttime drive on a wide main boulevard, speed limit 70 km/h, three lanes per side, sparse traffic, the road dominates intersections with green wave signaling, giving it high priority.

Rainy day on a main road through a commercial district, vehicles moving cautiously at 40 km/h due to wet conditions, two lanes each direction, moderate traffic, traffic lights manage the road's priority.
Traveling on a main highway with speed limit 100 km/h, four lanes wide, dense but flowing traffic of trucks and cars, this road has the highest priority as cross traffic is grade-separated.

Driving on a rural main road flanked by fields, speed limit 80 km/h, encountering only a couple of vehicles, intersections with minor roads have stop signs for crossing traffic, so main road has priority.

Passing a school zone on a main road, speed limit drops to 30 km/h, few cars around, single lane each direction, pedestrians crossing at designated crosswalk, the main road still has priority but with enhanced caution.

name: Busy
desc: Adjective attributes describing traffic or environmental state of the road.
extend_desc: Morning rush hour on a six-lane urban boulevard, bumper-to-bumper traffic moving at an average speed of 15 km/h, with frequent stop-and-go movements every few seconds.
Evening peak congestion on the downtown loop highway, all lanes packed with vehicles crawling at 10 km/h, brake lights flashing rhythmically ahead.
Midday busy intersection in the commercial district, dense streams of cars, buses and taxis crossing, with pedestrians filling the crosswalks, and the traffic light cycles barely clearing queues.
Late-night busy scenario near the entertainment strip, a four-lane road still congested with taxis and rideshares, average speed 25 km/h, occasional sudden stops.
School run hour on a suburban collector road, heavy traffic including school buses and parents’ SUVs, stop-and-go every 200 meters due to pedestrian crossings and bus stops.

A multi-lane roundabout during the morning peak, vehicles from all four approaches feed continuously, drivers must yield frequently within the circle, traffic density over 80 vehicles per km per lane.
Highway construction zone reducing three lanes to one, merging traffic creates a kilometer-long queue, stop-and-go frequency high, average speed drops to 5 km/h.
Interchange merge during evening rush, traffic from two highways converges, all lanes saturated, vehicles alternate merging in a slow zipper pattern, speed around 20 km/h.

name: Empty
desc: Adjective attributes describing traffic or environmental state of the road.
extend_desc: The highway stretches ahead with no vehicles in sight, the road surface dry and lane markings clearly visible under bright sunlight.
On a wide urban boulevard at midnight, the road is completely empty except for the occasional streetlight casting long shadows.
Driving along a winding country road, there hasn't been another vehicle for miles, with open fields on both sides and a gentle breeze.
The expressway is remarkably free-flowing, allowing the vehicle to maintain a steady 100 km/h with only a distant truck seen far ahead.
Early morning on a suburban street, the asphalt is still damp from dew, and there is no traffic at all, just birds chirping.
Navigating a mountain pass, the twisting road is entirely empty, with guardrails and steep cliffs but no other vehicles for the past ten minutes.
At night on a multi-lane freeway, the darkness is pierced only by our headlights, revealing an open road with no cars ahead or behind.
Crossing a long bridge over calm waters, the lane is open and vacant, with only sparse traffic glimpsed far in the opposite direction.

name: Curvy
desc: Adjective attributes describing traffic or environmental state of the road.
extend_desc: The vehicle navigates a steep mountain pass with hairpin turns, a 20 km/h advisory sign warns of the tight 180-degree bend ahead, and guardrails frame the edge as the valley drops away deeply.
Rolling hills unfold along a countryside road, gentle curves maintain a steady 60 km/h pace, and a tractor ahead pulls into a layby to let the faster traffic through.
In a dense autumn forest, the road snakes left around a blind corner, fallen leaves blur the asphalt edges, and the sight distance shrinks to under 50 meters before the bend.
Under a starry sky, the coastal highway sweeps through a series of rhythmic curves, headlights picking out reflective delimiters and the ocean shimmering far below.
Heavy rain slicks the asphalt on a suburban curvy road, an S-bend tightens sharply with a 30 km/h speed limit, and water gathers in the apex ruts.
A divided highway flows into a long sweeping curve with a radius over 500 meters, the 120 km/h limit feels unhurried as the road arcs across open farmland.
A snow-packed mountain pass forces a crawl, the road zigzags between rock walls, a 15 km/h advisory blinks, and the sightline past each icy corner is barely a car length.
Dusk settles as the car enters a 'Winding Road Next 5 km' zone, a rapid sequence of left‑right curves tests the suspension, and an oncoming vehicle’s headlights flare before dipping away.

name: Shadowed
desc: Adjective attributes describing traffic or environmental state of the road.
extend_desc: The vehicle traverses an urban boulevard at 8 AM, with tall buildings on the left casting long, crisp shadows that blanket approximately 45% of the road surface, sharply reducing contrast and creating alternating bright-dark patches.

On a winding countryside road at noon, a continuous canopy of overhanging trees casts dense, dappled shadows covering over 90% of the lane, with leaf-patterned light flecks moving rapidly across the windshield.

During early evening on a suburban street, low-angle sunlight from the west projects elongated shadows of houses and fences across 70% of the pavement, causing severe contrast reduction where dark stripes hide potholes.

Driving on a mountain highway at 3 PM, the sheer rock face on the right throws a solid shadow covering 60% of both lanes, leaving only a narrow sunlit strip on the left, making oncoming vehicles suddenly emerge from darkness.

In a tunnel-like underpass at 10 AM, the shadow coverage snaps to 100% instantly, causing a dramatic contrast drop and momentary blindness when transitioning from bright daylight, with brake lights of preceding cars the only visible markers.

A downtown intersection at 5 PM under partly cloudy skies, where moving cloud shadows sweep across 30% of the asphalt, momentarily darkening pedestrian crossings and causing unpredictable illumination shifts.

On a rural highway at sunrise, the low rear-facing sun casts a shadow of the ego vehicle itself across 40% of the road ahead, duplicating the car's silhouette and confusing depth perception for puddles and debris.

Cruising on an expressway at midday, scattered high clouds create mottled shadows covering 20% of the surface, but an oncoming bridge abruptly plunges a 100-meter stretch into total shadow, reducing contrast by a factor of three.

name: TrafficParticipants
desc: Conditions related to other road users and traffic regulation.
extend_desc: A sparse flow of vehicles moves smoothly along a rural highway, with a pickup truck in the right lane and a sedan ahead in the left, all maintaining safe following distances under clear morning light.
Heavy rush-hour congestion clogs a four-lane urban artery; directly ahead a bus and several cars inch forward in stop-and-go traffic, while motorcyclists weave cautiously between lanes.
At a busy downtown intersection, a dense mix of pedestrians cross with the walk signal as a line of taxis and a double-decker bus wait at the red light, the crosswalk packed with office workers.

On a narrow suburban street, a cyclist ahead drifts slightly into the traffic lane without signaling, while an oncoming SUV crosses the center line to leave room, near a school zone with parked cars lining the curb.

Late at night on a residential boulevard, traffic participants are few: a single sedan cruising well under the speed limit, a jogger on the sidewalk, and a delivery van idling with hazard lights on at the roadside.

On an expressway during the evening commute, bumper-to-bumper traffic stalls; directly in front a hatchback repeatedly stops and goes, flanked by a lorry on the right and a motorcycle filtering through the still columns of vehicles.

Approaching a school crossing in a quiet neighborhood, the flashing lights are active; a crossing guard halts all vehicles, while children with backpacks pour onto the pavement and a row of cars, including ours, comes to a complete stop.

In a narrow market district, a chaotic stream of participants pulses through: scooters carrying entire families, hand-pulled carts, and a few auto-rickshaws all jockey for position, some blatantly running a stale red light as our vehicle brakes to avoid conflict.

name: TrafficFlow
desc: Conditions related to other road users and traffic regulation.
extend_desc: The highway is heavily congested with bumper-to-bumper traffic, vehicles creeping along at under 5 km/h, all lanes packed densely with a mix of sedans, SUVs, and heavy trucks.
Traffic flows smoothly on the urban expressway at a steady 65 km/h, moderate density with cars and minivans evenly spaced across the four lanes.
On a quiet rural two-lane road, only a handful of vehicles appear in the distance ahead, all moving at the speed limit with low density and no congestion.
